title: Assessment of Alzheimer-related Pathologies of Dementia Using Machine Learning Feature Selection
authors: Rajab MD; Jammeh E; Taketa T; Brayne C; Matthews FE; Su L; Ince PG; Wharton SB; Wang D
one_liner_zh: 该研究用机器学习特征选择评估痴呆相关神经病理，与蛋白质-DNA互作及TF-DNA结合建模完全无关。
abstract: Although a variety of brain lesions may contribute to the pathological diagnosis of dementia, the relationship of these lesions to dementia, how they interact and how to quantify them remain uncertain. Systematically assessing neuropathological measures in relation to the cognitive and functional definitions of dementia may enable the development of better diagnostic systems and treatment targets. The objective of this study is to apply machine learning approaches for feature selection to identify key features of Alzheimer-related pathologies associated with dementia. We applied machine learning techniques for feature ranking and classification as an unbiased comparison of neuropathological features and assessment of their diagnostic performance using a cohort (n=186) from the Cognitive Function and Ageing Study (CFAS). Seven feature ranking methods using different information criteria consistently ranked 22 out of the 34 neuropathology features for importance to dementia classification. Braak neurofibrillary tangle stage, Beta-amyloid and cerebral amyloid angiopathy features were the most highly ranked, although were highly correlated with each other. The best performing dementia classifier using the top eight ranked neuropathology features achieved 79% sensitivity, 69% specificity, and 75% precision. A substantial proportion (40.4%) of dementia cases was consistently misclassified by all seven algorithms and any combination of the 22 ranked features. These results highlight the potential of using machine learning to identify key indices of plaque, tangle and cerebral amyloid angiopathy burdens that may be useful for the classification of dementia.
abstract_zh: 尽管多种脑部病变可能促成痴呆的病理诊断，但这些病变与痴呆的关系、它们如何相互作用以及如何量化仍不确定。系统评估神经病理学指标与痴呆的认知及功能定义之间的关联，可能有助于开发更优的诊断系统和治疗靶点。本研究旨在应用机器学习方法进行特征选择，以识别与痴呆相关的阿尔茨海默病理关键特征。我们利用机器学习技术进行特征排序和分类，作为对神经病理学特征的无偏比较及其诊断性能评估，采用来自认知功能与老龄化研究（CFAS）的队列（n=186）。七种使用不同信息标准的特征排序方法一致地将34个神经病理学特征中的22个排序为对痴呆分类重要。Braak神经原纤维缠结分期、β-淀粉样蛋白和脑淀粉样血管病特征排名最高，尽管它们彼此高度相关。使用排名前八的神经病理学特征的最佳痴呆分类器实现了79%的敏感性、69%的特异性和75%的精确度。相当比例（40.4%）的痴呆病例被所有七种算法及22个排序特征的任何组合一致地错误分类。这些结果凸显了利用机器学习识别斑块、缠结和脑淀粉样血管病负担关键指标的潜力，这些指标可能有助于痴呆的分类。
